purpose: Offline English evidence-support screening, fixed public project summaries. Each source is scored against one paraphrase, one contradiction and one claim absent from the source. Previously examined source register; new claims. This pilot tests classification, not citation selection or generation.
protocol: Read only the finding field as the first sequence and the claim as the second. Use the shipped tokenizer with special tokens, CPU ONNX Runtime 1.24.4 and softmax class 1 probability >=0.5 as SUPPORTED (class 0 UNSUPPORTED). Exactly 24 calls, no retries, all rows retained. Proceed to wider independent testing only if at least 7/8 supported paraphrases are accepted and at most 1/8 contradictions and at most 1/8 absent claims are accepted. A pass is a pilot outcome.

cases.supported: Results from a simulator may differ from performance on the actual phone.
cases.contradicted: The simulator is guaranteed to match performance on the physical device.
cases.absent: The iPhone Air generated 25 tokens per second in the team's device trial.

cases.supported: A Personal Team profile lasts one week from issuance.
cases.contradicted: Personal Team provisioning profiles last thirty days after issuance.
cases.absent: A Personal Team account can register twelve iPhones in a week.

cases.supported: A Worker can pass a model identifier and an input object to the AI binding.
cases.contradicted: The AI binding accepts only a model identifier and rejects an input object.
cases.absent: The hosted model completed this project's first inference in 180 milliseconds.

cases.supported: The daily free allowance is ten thousand neurons.
cases.contradicted: The daily free allowance is one thousand neurons.
cases.absent: Each of our research questions will consume exactly fifty neurons.

cases.supported: A link to a primary source and a link to an earlier revision express different relationships.
cases.contradicted: A primary-source link has exactly the same meaning as a revision link.
cases.absent: The project retained eleven revisions of the primary source.

cases.supported: Text surrounding an exact quotation can distinguish repeated passages.
cases.contradicted: A text quote selector identifies passages only by page number and ignores their wording.
cases.absent: The recommended amount of surrounding text is exactly forty characters on either side.

cases.supported: ALCE evaluates fluency, correctness, and citation quality.
cases.contradicted: ALCE excludes citation quality from its evaluation.
cases.absent: The model leading the published evaluation scored ninety percent for citation quality.

cases.supported: Some plausible questions have no answer supported by the supplied passage.
cases.contradicted: Every question can be answered from the supplied passage.
cases.absent: Exactly one third of the study's questions were unanswerable.
